title: Supervisory Stress Test Documentation Credit Risk Models
summary: This Federal Reserve document (October 2025, updated January 2026) provides technical documentation on credit risk models used in the 2026 Supervisory Stress Test. It covers seven model categories: Corporate, Commercial Real Estate, First Lien Mortgage, Home Equity, Credit Card, Auto, and Other Retail. The January 2026 revision added transparency on model coefficients and made technical corrections.
key_points: Document details credit risk model methodology for 2026 Supervisory Stress Test covering seven retail and corporate credit categories
January 2026 updates provided additional transparency on coefficients used in proposed credit risk models
Technical corrections included revisions to loan category assignments, spline knot interpretations, and table corrections in First Lien LGD Model
Document is primarily technical reference material for bank supervisors assessing capital adequacy under adverse scenarios
Source metadata target topic 'market structure' does not accurately reflect document content, which focuses on credit risk modeling methodology
why_it_matters: This documentation establishes the analytical framework the Federal Reserve will use to assess whether large banks can absorb losses under adverse economic scenarios. The 2026 stress test results will determine capital distribution restrictions for major financial institutions.
